search_objective: maximize number of deadline-feasible tasks; strict improvement; first best on ties
residual_policy: append unselected tasks to earliest-free robot using minimum travel+service time
cost: sum(finish_time/deadline for every task with finish_time > deadline), after residual completion
fidelity: paper-algorithm reimplementation with documented continuous-time and full-coverage adapters; not author-code replication

timing.includes: ctypes solve wrapper, pairwise travel/service preparation, entire search, residual completion, route extraction
timing.excludes: compilation, library/model loading, dataset I/O, tensor conversion, warmup, independent route replay, metrics and result I/O
timing.clock: perf_counter wall time; process_time also reported

ils.selection_rule: group1 -> tight parameters, group2 -> slack parameters; selected by input group, not outcome

eils.selection_rule: group1 -> tight parameters, group2 -> slack parameters; selected by input group, not outcome
